description: Native Cap'n Proto runtime for Janet plus a C library embedders can link without the Janet VM. Packed and canonical codecs are byte-identical with official capnp. Includes capnpc-janet.
rules: capnp_get_u32(const capnp_ptr_t *p, uint32_t off, uint32_t dflt) returns uint32_t. It is not an out-parameter API.
Allocate and set fields in schema declaration order for official capnp encode byte parity.
Both a Janet module (import capnp) and a plain C API (capnp-janet/capnp_message.h) exist. Embedders do not need the Janet VM.
Packed and canonical forms are byte-identical with Cap'n C++ / capnp convert on AddressBook goldens.
